ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #16
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19.6
   C. 19.7
   D. 19

2. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 6x
   D. 12x

3. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31.6
   C. 31
   D. 31.7

4. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.6
   B. 23.7
   C. 23
   D. 29

5. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 27
   C. 27.6
   D. 27.7

6. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 32
   C. 12
   D. 33

7. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 30
   C. 44
   D. 15

8. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 000 m²
   B. 10 000 m²
   C. 100 m²
   D. 1000 m²

9. What is √36? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 36
   C. 6
   D. 7

10. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 21
   C. 20
   D. 9

11. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. Cannot tell
   C. 1/4
   D. 2/2

12. Solve for x: x + 3 = 8. (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 5
   C. 3
   D. 8

13. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 18
   C. 82
   D. 9

14. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 42
   C. 12
   D. 24

15. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 156
   C. 24
   D. 144

16. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170
   B. 169
   C. 13
   D. 26

17. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 49

18. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 38
   C. 19
   D. 60

19. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 43
   D. 2

20. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 40

21. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.7
   B. 15.6
   C. 21
   D. 15

22. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2, 4, 6
   B. 1, 2, 3, 6
   C. 3, 6, 9
   D. 1, 6

23. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 5
   C. 1
   D. 7

24. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 40

25. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 36
   C. 81
   D. 90

26. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 28

   C. 11
   D. 3

27. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49

   C. 50
   D. 14

28. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 14
   C. 49
   D. 2

29. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

30. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 65
   B. 64
   C. 0
   D. 16

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
